No, as framed it is inadmissible. The defendant may offer evidence of his character for honesty, but only through reputation or opinion testimony (FRE 404(a)(2)(A) and 405(a)), and a witness who knows him can testify to that. Testimony about specific instances, such as the defendant turning down black-marketeering offers, cannot be used on direct examination to prove his character, though his service as a supply sergeant may be admissible as background.

CONFIDENCE: 82
